name: poll
title: Poll
description: A question, a few answers, and how the votes fell once one is chosen.
use: A quick vote in a feed, a chat or a document. Each answer is a label around a native radio, or a checkbox when several may be chosen. Set each answer's share as --value in percent and write it in poll-value: both show once an answer is checked, or from the start when the inputs are disabled because the poll is over.

instead.when: The options explain themselves in a sentence and no result follows
It is a plain option in a form
Only the result is shown and nobody votes

keyboard.action: Move between the answers of a radio group and choose the one they land on
Chooses the focused answer, or clears a checkbox

classes.name: poll
classes.description: The group, on a fieldset or an element with role="group": answers 8px apart

classes.name: poll-title
classes.description: The question, on the legend or a heading

classes.name: poll-option
classes.description: One answer, on a label: a flat face 38px tall that fills from its start with a tint as long as its share; chosen, it takes an ink contour and a check

classes.name: poll-input
classes.description: The native radio or checkbox inside the answer. It covers the answer and is not drawn

classes.name: poll-value
classes.description: The answer's share as text, at the end; hidden until the result shows

classes.name: poll-meta
classes.description: A quiet line under the answers: how many voted, how long is left

states.name: chosen
states.description: The answer is chosen, and with it the result shows: every answer fills to its share and its figure appears

states.name: over
states.description: The poll is closed: the result shows from the start and nothing can be chosen

properties.name: --value
properties.description: The answer's share of the votes, from 0 to 100

properties.name: --poll-color
properties.description: The ink the shares are tinted with

example: Which name should ship?
